Want to subscribe and follow me on instagram?! Cool me too! @8thWeekday 

Rick and Morty made their own pair of Japanese selvedge raw denim jeans! Well, Naked and Famous Denim technically did but I'm sure Rick had a say on his pair. How cool! How fun! Wubba lubba dub dub! Mr. Meeseeks! What else could you possible want? Would Levi's ever do something as cool as this? NOPE! Only Naked and Famous Denim in all of their glory. Also ever wondered why I always say Japanese raw selvedge denim jeans and make these paragraphs sound weird? Well because I think it helps my SEO? I don't even know. Anyways - goodbye see you next week.
